raw.details:
Overview

DATANYX'26 is Telangana’s flagship 24-hour datathon, now in its third edition. It is organized by AWS Student Builder Group MJCET and IEEE SMC MJCET.

It is a 24-hour event where you take raw data and turn it into a working prototype. You start from scratch. The problem statements, datasets are given to you on the first day.

DATANYX started in 2024 as the first 24 hr datathon in Telangana. In 2025, it grew into a national event. This year, every problem is linked to the UN Sustainable Development Goals. So what you build can help solve real problems in the world.

Domains:

  • AgroTech (SDG 2, 12, 13, 15)
  • EdTech (SDG 1, 4, 8)
  • Urban Tech (SDG 6, 7, 9, 11)
  • MedTech (SDG 3, 5, 10)

Event Details:

  • Dates: 28th and 29th November 2026
  • Venue: Ghulam Ahmed Hall, MJCET, Hyderabad
  • Mode: Offline

Event Structure:

  • Phase 1 - Shortlisting Round (Online): In the first phase, teams are required to submit a unique problem statement of their own creation, accompanied by a solution abstract with a presentation that aligns with their selected domain. Teams must choose from one of the following domains: Med Tech, Urban Tech, Agro Tech or EdTech. The proposed presentation should reflect originality and innovation within the chosen domain.All submissions must be completed online on the provided PPT Template before the designated deadline.
  • The DATANYX'26 PPT TEMPLATE & the DOMAIN DESCRIPTION are attached below .
  • Phase 2 - Finals (MJCET): The top 15 teams from each domain will qualify for the final phase, held in person at MJCET, Hyderabad. Here, teams will be given a new problem statement revealed on the spot along with a sample dataset. They will then have 24 hours to brainstorm, design, implement, build, and submit their final solutions. This phase tests the teams' ability to think critically and collaborate effectively under pressure, turning ideas into impactful solutions within a limited timeframe.

Shortlisted teams are required to pay a participation fee of ₹1000.

Step 1: Getting Started:

  • Click the Unstop link for Datanyx.
  • Find the "Register" button and click it.

Step 2: Sign In (Super Easy!):

  • Choose your sign-in option:
    • Google (fastest!)
    • LinkedIn
    • Email
  • Enter your details:
    • Phone number
    • Email
    • Wait for the OTP on your phone and enter it.

Step 3: Your Basic Info:

  • Fill in the following details:
    • Your name
    • School or workplace
    • Course details
    • Graduation date
    • Country of residence

Step 4: Team Formation:

  • If you’re the Team Leader:
    • Create your team:
      • Choose a team name.
      • Add teammates' emails.
      • Remind them to check their email for the "View Opportunity" link.
      • Watch for teammates' names to turn GREEN once they join!
  • If you're joining someone’s team:
    • Find the team name.
    • Click "Send Request".
    • Wait for the team leader to add you.

Step 5: PPT Submission:

  • Download the PPT template
  • Create your PPT with the team
  • Submit your PPT in the PPT  Submission box in PDF format.

Step 6: Final Check:

  • Find the "View Details" button.
    • If it's GREEN = You’re all set!
    • If it's RED = Someone still needs to confirm.

Pro Tip: Make sure everyone confirms their participation—green names mean your team is ready!

Judging: Teams are judged on accuracy, robustness, explainability, and how realistic their business plan is.

Prizes: Rs 1,00,000 prize pool.

Guidelines:

  • Please follow the given format for the abstract PPT, or else your registration will be regarded as invalid.
  • There is NO registration fee for the first round. The shortlisted teams (finalists) have to pay Rs. 1000 to confirm their participation in the second round.
  • Cross year, cross specializations, and cross college teams are allowed.
  • The Datathon is based on a 24-hour format.
  • The timings for the Datanyx'26 are from 11 AM on the 28th of November to 11 AM on the 29th of November.
  • Shortlisted teams are requested to travel to MJCET, Hyderabad, on their own; no travel allowances will be provided.
  • Goodies will be provided to the shortlisted teams.
  • Food and refreshments will be provided to the shortlisted teams.
  • This Datathon is open to international students.
